newsitem.title: USA: Boyfriend of accused Cosby extortionist charged.
newsitem.headline: Boyfriend of accused Cosby extortionist charged.

text.p: The boyfriend of the woman charged with trying to extort $40 million from entertainer Bill Cosby by claiming she is his illegitimate daughter pleaded guilty in the case on Tuesday and is cooperating with authorities, according to court records.
The woman, Autumn Jackson, 22, was released from federal prison on Monday on a $250,000 personal recognisance bond.
Her boyfriend Antonay Williams appeared in a court proceeding in Manhattan federal court and pleaded guilty to conspiracy and extortion.
He told the court he helped Jackson and an accomplice Jose Medina try to extort money from Cosby by threatening to disclose to the media that Cosby was her father.

He said his involvement included doing research on Cosby and Cosby's corporate sponsors, receiving a document from a representative of the tabloid The Globe and helping Jackson and Medina get to the Los Angeles airport on Jan. 17.
Williams, 26, of Perry, Fla. faces a possible maximum sentence of seven years and fines of $500,000. He was released on a $250,000 personal recognisance bond.
